g.text: ~QueryExpansionService(client : OllamaClient, cache : QueryExpansionCache, warmUpTimeout : Duration, nanoClock : LongSupplier)
~OllamaClient(baseUrl : String, model : String, generateTimeout : Duration, healthTimeout : Duration)
+generate(prompt : String, maxTokens : int, timeout : Duration) : String
-send(prompt : String, maxTokens : int, timeout : Duration) : String
cache hit -> cached terms; otherwise generate(prompt(query)),
parse() (comma split, trim, lower-case, drop terms over
3 words or 40 chars, dedupe, at most 8) and put() into the cache.
logged, returns an empty list, nothing cached,
and startRecovery() runs warmUp() on a daemon thread
"ollama-recovery": at most one at a time, starts at least
RECOVERY_INTERVAL apart, or RECOVERY_RETRY_INTERVAL after a
warm-up that failed with ConnectException; expand() never waits for it.
also after an index build, before POST /api/index answers;
caches nothing, logs its time, never throws, true if answered.
LRU, synchronized: HashMap for lookup plus a doubly
linked list, head (most recent) ... tail (least recent).
get() and put() move the node to the front;
put() over capacity evicts the tail.
and uses the given timeout; throws IOException on timeout,
connection failure, non-200 or a body without "response".
